definitions.all5: sum five horizon E/W/B, with equal condition/candidate/time weight within each scene; model score is ratio of mean per-scene normalized sums, matching pilot weighting.
definitions.all_candidates: all cached unique candidates retained, including zero-action candidate; no candidates/scenes filtered.
definitions.canonical_strict: only exact same-target candidate/time cells are canonicalized: each history row uses its diagonal distance for both target columns; LeWM baseline is recomputed directly from native pred/target, DINO baseline remains cached distance after byte-identical future-pixel confirmation. No tolerance threshold is used.
definitions.first_step: uses Bfirst only, not the shared all-horizon denominator.
definitions.future_rate: strict d[h,h] < d[h,1-h], equally across the two histories, candidates and horizons; exact ties count as false.
definitions.history_rate: strict correct-history prediction error < opposite-history prediction error for each target condition; exact ties count as false.
definitions.raw: strict comparisons and E/W from stored distance cache, before same-target numerical-tie canonicalization.

dino_target_separation_energy_alignment.interpretation: Per-scene/per-horizon scalar energy alignment only; this alone does not establish all target vectors are equal.

distance_source: Existing distance_*.npz; no DINO feature-space scoring.

purpose: Same cached actions/horizons: compare strict selection/history decisions with complete normalized prediction scores.

bootstrap.interval: percentile 95% CI (2.5th, 97.5th); NRE, common bias/B, and E/B recomputed per draw
bootstrap.sampling_unit: source_group, resampling group ids with replacement and retaining every scene in each selected group

definitions.E_over_B: sum(complete matched prediction error E) / sum(target_separation energy B) = NRE_response_over_B + common_bias_energy/B
definitions.Gain: sum((pred_1-pred_0)*(target_1-target_0)) / sum((target_1-target_0)^2); for two conditions G=(E_wrong-E_matched)/B=4*Gain
definitions.NRE_response_over_B: sum(response_error_energy) / sum(target_separation_energy B); two conditions; same v1 scene normalization and source-group aggregation
definitions.aggregation: Within each scene, sum conditions/candidates/five horizons then divide by conditions*candidates*horizons; across scenes, sum normalized energy terms and form ratios. Zero-B scene ratios are never synthesized; model-level B must be positive.
definitions.common_bias_energy: complete matched prediction error E minus centered response error; for LeWM independently checked as 2 * sum((mean_condition(pred)-mean_condition(target))^2)

scope.candidate_scope: all v1 cached unique candidates, including zero-action candidate; no scene/candidate filtering

verification_scope.DINO-WM: All 1,536 scene records use existing native receipt E/response/B sums, checked against v1 query summaries and panel source identities; no pooled feature tensor was loaded or scored; full-DINO independent recomputation is not claimed.
verification_scope.LeWM: All 512 scene feature caches independently recomputed from full native pred/target tensors; E, centered response, target separation B, cross-history error, common bias, Gain, and G=4*Gain checked against receipts and v1 query summaries.
verification_scope.claim_boundary: Response decomposition is a cached-model diagnosis for root-cause analysis; it does not establish unified physical accuracy or a frozen benchmark score.
verification_scope.source_identity: Each receipt scene source_sha256 was matched by scene_id to its task panel manifest SHA; manifest SHA was also matched to the model receipt.
